# Independent numerical fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate-dpdfnet-fixtures.py` from the SHA-pinned upstream DPDFNet-2 48 kHz ONNX model, using NumPy 2.1.3 and ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 on the development machine.

All files contain little-endian FP32 values. `model-inputs` and `model-outputs` contain 12 consecutive complex spectrum frames (962 floats each); `model-final-state` contains the 56,436 recurrent-state values after those frames. `audio-input` contains 48,000 synthetic samples, and `audio-output` contains the corresponding causal analysis/model/synthesis output with the 2,400-sample delay removed and the tail flushed.

Input is deterministic synthetic noise plus two gated sinusoids; no user audio is included. Tests use the committed binary vectors without Python or an ONNX runtime. The model/output attribution is covered by `../../NOTICE.md`.
